description: This file implements GPIO driver functions for the Cypress PSoC6 microcontroller within the Zephyr RTOS, including configuration, port access, interrupt handling, and callback management.

methods.name: gpio_psoc6_config
methods.description: Configures a GPIO pin with specified flags, setting drive mode, pull-up/down, input buffer, and other parameters.

methods.name: gpio_psoc6_port_get_raw
methods.description: Reads the raw input value of the GPIO port.

methods.name: gpio_psoc6_port_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets multiple GPIO pins simultaneously using a mask and value.

methods.name: gpio_psoc6_port_set_bits_raw
methods.description: Sets specific GPIO pins high based on a mask.

methods.name: gpio_psoc6_port_clear_bits_raw
methods.description: Clears specific GPIO pins based on a mask.

methods.name: gpio_psoc6_port_toggle_bits
methods.description: Toggles specific GPIO pins based on a mask.

methods.name: gpio_psoc6_pin_interrupt_configure
methods.description: Configures interrupt mode and trigger for a GPIO pin.

methods.name: gpio_psoc6_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for GPIO interrupts, clears interrupt and fires callbacks.

methods.name: gpio_psoc6_manage_callback
methods.description: Manages callback registration for GPIO events.

methods.name: gpio_psoc6_get_pending_int
methods.description: Returns pending interrupt status for the GPIO port.

methods.name: gpio_psoc6_init
methods.description: Initializes the GPIO device, calling configuration function.
